prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: full-bleed landscape background artwork for the Windows launcher of 숲켓몬, a Korean collectible fantasy RPG. Create ONLY the artwork, no interface or text.
Primary request: an exceptionally polished, cinematic premium game-launcher background, elegant and richly detailed rather than a generic wallpaper.
Scene: a monumental dark fantasy citadel and a circular stone portal overlooking a vast moonlit valley. The portal is on the right third, with an ancient metallic ring and concentrated pale chartreuse light inside it, a few floating stone fragments and delicate luminous particles. Low stairs and carved slate floor guide the eye into it. Beyond it, distant fortress spires and clouds create depth. The left 45 percent stays dark navy with subtle mist, atmospheric architectural silhouettes and very quiet detail, intentionally readable behind a logo and text. Bottom edge also darker for launcher controls.
Style: high-end collectible RPG environment illustration, refined painterly finish with precise stone and brushed metal detail, dramatic wide composition; no pixel art or smeared texture.
Palette: midnight navy #080c17, slate blue, muted silver, carefully concentrated lime #c8ff6b rim light. Dark and sophisticated; bright focal point must stay on the right and not overwhelm the whole scene.
Composition: landscape approximately 16:9, full bleed, strong depth, no borders. Clear attractive silhouette at small launcher size. No characters, no lettering, no logo, no UI, no badges, no buttons, no floating card mockups.
intent: Windows launcher environment artwork; existing approved game character art and logo remain unmodified.
